query:
SELECT
            ds.uuid AS "data_source!: DataSourceUuid",
            f.rel_path,
            f.stage AS "stage!: IngestFailureStage",
            f.error
        FROM ingest_file_failures f
        JOIN ingests i ON i.id = f.ingest_id
        JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id = i.data_source_id
        WHERE i.uuid = ?
        ORDER BY f.id
